name: npm-supply-chain-check
description: Check whether an npm package is safe to install before adding or upgrading it — known malware, vulnerabilities for the exact version, recent publisher or maintainer changes (the account-takeover pattern behind ua-parser-js, event-stream and the 2025 chalk/debug compromise), missing or mismatched publish provenance, install scripts, and typosquat names. Use when the user or the agent is about to run npm/pnpm/yarn/bun install or add a dependency, asks "is X safe," "was X compromised," "can I trust
author: salemalem
